text:
ria: quick follow-up from the postmortem. pattern: rollouts with wide exposure + no fast rollback. we need a short, actionable list and clear owners.

owen: I can build a tiny rollback endpoint that flips a flag and sends an audit event. prototype in 5 days. minimal API: `POST /internal/rollback` with flag, target, reason. idempotent required.

pat: i'll own blast-radius defaults and enforcement in the gateway. propose default route cap 5%, region cap 10%, with soft-override TTL and approver audit.

deploy-bot: note: recent monitor shows 4 high-exposure flags in last 120 days.

ria: ops needs a one-page oncall checklist for verification when rollback occurs. pat + owen coordinate to ensure the rollback emits a verification URL.

owen: sample CLI for emergency rollback: `ri rollback exec --flag ranker-v3 --target stable --reason "ops"`

ria: action items:
- A1: rollback endpoint + audit stream (owner: owen) — due: 2024-06-05
- A2: gateway enforcement for route caps + soft-override (owner: pat) — due: 2024-05-30
- A3: oncall verification checklist + runbook update (owner: ria) — due: 2024-05-28
- A4: synthetic rollback test in staging CI (owner: owen + infra) — due: 2024-06-07
- A5: dashboard for high-exposure flags + weekly audit job (owner: pat) — due: 2024-06-14

pat: acceptance checks: policy schema unit tests, negative tests for override TTL, enforcement metrics.

owen: dependency: needs kinesis audit topic and feature-flag safe toggle lib. i'll open tickets.

ria: we'll review status in next platform sync. please add acceptance criteria to your tickets before EOD. tagging @pat @owen. :thumbsup:
